whatIsIt.eli5: A cheap helper made from little single-layer steps and mixing steps.
whatIsIt.simple: YOLOv10's compact block: depthwise 3×3 → pointwise 1×1 (expand) → depthwise (3×3, or 7×7 RepVGGDW) → pointwise 1×1 → depthwise 3×3, with a shortcut.
whatIsIt.engineer: cv1 = Seq(DW3×3(c1), PW(c1→2c_), DW3×3 or RepVGGDW(2c_), PW(2c_→c2), DW3×3(c2)); residual if c1 == c2.

whyExists.eli5: Cheap steps mean more of them fit in a small budget.
whyExists.simple: Depthwise convolutions are very cheap, so deep stages can stay strong with fewer parameters (rank-guided design in the paper).
whyExists.engineer: Inverted-bottleneck structure with depthwise spatial mixing; used where intrinsic rank analysis shows redundancy.

eli5: Look around each layer of notes alone.
Repeat, then add back the start.
simple: Five steps alternating depthwise (spatial) and pointwise (channel) convolutions.
Optional large 7×7 kernel in the middle (lk=True) for a wider view.
engineer: RepVGGDW = 7×7 DW + 3×3 DW in training, fused to one 7×7 at export.
